notes.title: AI LIMIT Patch Notes STEAM&PS5
notes.notes:
[b]※【PC】If you encounter infinite loading or a black screen after updating the game, please try the following steps:

Update to the latest version and verify the integrity of your game files:
 Right-click the game in your Steam Library → Select “Properties” → Go to “Installed Files” → Click “Verify integrity of game files”.

If the issue persists:
 - Go to Steam Settings → “Downloads” → Disable “Shader Pre-Caching”.
 - Right-click the game → “Properties” → Disable Cloud Saves, then restart Steam.
 - If none of the above resolves the issue, try reinstalling the game.[/b]

Thank you to all players for your valuable feedback and bug reports. We will continue to listen to your voices and respond swiftly with improvements.
The current version of the game is generally stable. Some remaining issues—identified but requiring further testing or longer-term solutions—will be addressed in future patches.

The following changes apply to PC ver. 1.0.023 & PS5 ver. 1.000.024

[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] 【PC】Improved the interaction logic between VSYNC and LOCK FPS settings.
[*] Optimized shop behavior: in NG+ cycles, Moose’s no longer requires re-unlocking to purchase weapon upgrade materials.
[*] Fixed an issue where respawn points could be incorrectly placed in certain situations.
[/list]

[b]Levels and Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted collision and hitbox logic for some bosses to reduce the chance of players being pushed out of the arena.
[*] Fixed camera culling issues in specific areas.
[*] Fixed boundary issues in certain levels.
[*] Fixed a bug where some bosses could unintentionally fall out of their designated combat area.
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed visual issues related to the protagonist and certain level areas.
[*] Fixed lingering visual effects from some skills that remained in the environment for too long.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Other Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected display issues for some UI elements and text.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Spell Flame Jet would continue to remain active after entering the next area under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed bugs where certain weapon skills or spells could incorrectly cause the character to remain airborne.
[/list]

[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain achievements would not unlock properly.

[*] Fixed a bug where items would not drop if Arrisa and a boss died simultaneously. (If you've already encountered this issue, the item will now appear when revisiting the relevant area.)

[list]

[*] Addressed several issues involving support NPCs.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to walk across an inactive mechanism bridge in Hagios Patir – Lower Level.
[*] Fixed an issue where Aether, the Father could be unintentionally defeated.
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various visual glitches related to level geometry and enemy appearances.

[*] Addressed additional visual inconsistencies in cinematic sequences.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Added map markers for collected Soil, and corrected several labeling errors.
[*] Fixed an issue where map markers would not display after the map had remained unopened for an extended period.
[*] Resolved a bug where certain special enemies would incorrectly spawn in boss arenas.
[*] Fixed missing Russian language options in initial setup.
[*] Resolved an issue where the protagonist could be attacked by enemies during story dialogue scenes.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could obtain duplicate Main Seals in New Game+.
[*] Addressed several other minor and rare bugs.

notes.title: AI LIMIT Hotfix Announcement:
notes.notes:
We sincerely apologize for the bugs encountered at launch.

If you experience any of the following issues, please exit Steam and update the 6.5GB patch:

·Main menu text not displaying

·Stuck in the Lore Boss fight

·Deluxe Edition reward chest not appearing

If you continue to experience black screen issues, achievements not unlocking, infinite loading, or missing Russian text after updating, please try the following:

·Right-click the game in your Steam library → Select "Properties" → Go to "Installed Files" → Click "Verify integrity of game files"

·Open Steam settings → Go to the "Downloads" section → Disable "Enable Shader Pre-Caching" to improve performance

If the issue persists, please uninstall and reinstall the game.

Additionally, if the "Language Selection" screen at the start does not display Russian, please select another language to enter the game, then switch to Russian in the "Game Settings" menu.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: AI LIMIT Release Date Set for March 27, 2025
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your long-standing support to AI LIMIT. I am Jiawei Zhou (@AirChip8701), the publishing lead at CE-Asia, the publisher of AI LIMIT. On January 19th, we released the trailer for AI LIMIT, which garnered a lot of attention from players and media alike. This response has greatly encouraged us, and the enthusiasm from all of you continues to inspire us.

Although the development journey has been filled with challenges, in July this year, we released our first external demo and participated in the BitSummit in Kyoto, Japan. The enthusiasm from the players there was unforgettable, and being able to present exciting gameplay to them made all the hard work worthwhile.

Fast forward to October, when we officially released the demo on Steam and PlayStation during the Steam Next Fest. The demo quickly rose to the top of the popularity charts and stayed there for several days. While the rankings were impressive, we have always been focused on player feedback. Based on your responses, we quickly made adjustments to the game. However, we also realized that we needed more time to polish AI LIMIT to meet the expectations of all those who have supported and followed us.

Indeed, our first trailer and the Steam page indicated a release within 2024. However, after considering the enthusiastic feedback from players, and to further enhance the game’s quality and respond to the support and attention from all of you, we have ultimately decided to set the release date for [b]March 27, 2025[/b]. After these additional months of polishment, AI LIMIT will be presented with even better quality, whether in optimization or better details!

In the meantime, we have prepared a new gameplay trailer showcasing a new level. This video picks up from the October demo and features two boss battles, providing a deeper look into the game's world and enemy factions. We hope you enjoy it!

[previewyoutube=ChLfDR-V4tg;full][/previewyoutube]

During this period, we welcome all of your thoughts and feedback. AI LIMIT wouldn’t be where it is without your support and attention. Once again, thank you! We look forward to seeing you in Havenswell on [b]March 27, 2025[/b].

- Jiawei Zhou, on behalf of CE-Asia & Sense Games Team

notes.title: AI LIMIT Demo Version Update Log #1
notes.notes:
We sincerely thank all players for their valuable feedback and suggestions. The Demo version will continue to incorporate feedback from the player community, and adjustments will be made as quickly as possible. 

Below are the changes and fixes applied in Steam Build lD:16068753  / Version 1.0.009

1.System
  1.1 Fixed an issue where the mouse could not be used to allocate points in the "Upgrade" page.
  1.2 Optimized the information panel for the Primary Seal.
  1.3 Improved the camera movement speed when using the mouse.
  1.4 Temporarily turn off VSYNC and Motion Blur by default.

2.Combat Balance – Main Character
  2.1 Increased the damage of all weapons within the Dual weapons module.
  2.2 Reduced the startup time for weapon skill of the Blader Greatsword.
  2.3 Enhanced the Overload Burst damage and sync rate recovery of the Frame ability "Shield".
  2.4 Improved the Poise for the final attack in standard combos for the following weapons: Blader Greatsword, Serrated Halberd, Knight's Lance, and Impact Drill.

3.Combat Balance – Enemies in Stages
  3.1 Reduced HP for certain enemies.
  3.2 Lowered the poise and attack angle correction for all robot types.
  3.3 Decreased the HP and damage of the Lost Blader and Necro Floater.

4.Combat Balance – Boss: Lore, the Lost Lancer
  4.1 Decreased the Boss's HP and damage
  4.2 Shortened the hitbox duration for several attacks and reduced angle corrections.
  4.3 Fixed AI behavior logic issues.
  4.4 Lowered the remaining HP of the Boss after phase transitions.

5.Combat Balance – Challenge Boss: Hunter of Bladers
  5.1 Reduced the Boss's HP, sync rate damage, and the sync rate tier bonus to attack power.
  5.2 Decreased the sync rate recovery ability triggered by headaches.
  5.3 Lowered the frequency of backward flashes.
  5.4 Reduced the damage and angle correction for certain attacks.
  5.5 Shortened the hitbox duration for skills with explosion.

6.Other Details and Fixes
  6.1 Fixed a UI text error.
  6.2 Resolved missing subtitles in the Traditional Chinese and Japanese versions.
  6.3 Adjusted the facial features of the main character and fixed issues with cartoon render outlines.
  6.4 Optimized the item placement sequence in the tutorial area.
  6.5 Fixed a bug where reverse map running triggered hidden respawn points.
  6.6 Resolved scene component disappearance issues caused by occlusion culling.
  6.7 Improved performance in certain areas.
  6.8 Fixed a black screen issue during cutscenes on the PS5 version.

Additionally, based on the feedback received from the Demo, significant adjustments will be made to the balance and values in the official version.Once again, thank you all for your valuable feedback!
